scope: Static read-only review of root utility source. No formal utility execution, new predictions/generated text access, model load, or existing review overwrite.

findings.issue: If the AI-reviewed primary JS scope has no eligible pairs, the code still calls np.quantile on zero finite bootstrap values. The analyzer correctly emits NA; verifier would fail despite honest empty-scope output.
findings.recommended_fix: For zero finite priority replicates require empty adjusted CI fields and zero bootstrap_valid; only compute quantiles for nonempty supported scopes.
findings.resolution: Root owner updated verifier; independent follow-up static read confirms requested guard/linkage/output hash checks. No formal actual-result verifier execution was performed by reviewer.

findings.location: scripts/verify_followup.py pairrows read and verify_stat selection
findings.issue: Independent bootstrap uses exported pair *_difference, concordance and eligible fields without first deriving/checking them from independently checked target rows and frozen correct/error endpoint IDs. An upstream sign, ranking or eligibility bug could therefore be faithfully reproduced and pass this verifier.
findings.recommended_fix: Independently bind every pairrow to frozen pair endpoints; check e-c differences, behavior concordance ties, 1-confidence baseline, paired concordance difference, scope gates, and complete condition counts before resampling.
findings.resolution: Root owner updated verifier; independent follow-up static read confirms requested guard/linkage/output hash checks. No formal actual-result verifier execution was performed by reviewer.

findings.issue: Engine input bindings are checked, but recorded encode feature_file_sha256, infer encoder_feature_sha256, output_sha256 and dialogue_artifact_sha256 are not compared to actual output/cache files. Analysis exported output hashes are also not checked. The final source_and_artifact_hashes_verified=True claim would be broader than the checks performed.
findings.recommended_fix: Stream-hash actual encoder cache, perturbed CSV and dialogue predictions against engine recorded SHAs; verify analysis_verification output SHA map. No feature/model load is needed.
findings.resolution: Root owner updated verifier; independent follow-up static read confirms requested guard/linkage/output hash checks. No formal actual-result verifier execution was performed by reviewer.
